title: Biological needs escalate above ordinary goals before their consequence line (SURV-07) and a subject that cannot reach a bed in time rests where it stands
summary: Need goals escalate on the arrival level and give way to a present threat; rest in place via REST. Starvation 25.0/25.8/16.0 to 13.2/13.0/10.8 (part is free meals); crowded_frontier alive t=1000 18.2 to 7.8 disclosed (divergence 2.81).
